attacks.name: Inferno
steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.
Before |!damage| is dealt, other enemy characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Firewall
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character. The chosen character gains the |§root§Root| and |§slow§Slow| special conditions. This superpower may be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Stoke the Flames
superPowers.body: During the next attack action made by this character this Turn, add 2 dice to its attack rolls.

superPowers.name: Fire Manipulation
superPowers.body: When this character attacks, after the attack is resolved, if the defender has the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition, this character may choose another enemy character within |!range| 2 of the defender. The chosen character gains the Incinerate special condition.
